definition: Marital misconduct refers to conduct that is alleged to have caused the erosion of a marriage. In some states the spouse found guilty of marital misconduct will be adversely affected during property division, distribution of spousal support, or awarding attorney's fees. Marihuana Regulation & Taxation Act (MRTA) / marital misconduct Dictionary compilation | 26 September 2026 This case from Washington, explains that marital misconduct “refers to immoral or physically abusive conduct within the marital relationship and does not encompass gross fiscal improvidence, the squandering of marital assets or, the deliberate and unnecessary incurring of tax liabilities.”
